title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:25-34
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:25-34</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> Because of this I say to y’all, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">do not worry</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">about your</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">life-being</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        what you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">eat</char> or what you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">drink</char>; 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        not even about your <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">body</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        what you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">put on</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        Isn’t the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">living-being</char> more than <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">food</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">body</char> more than <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothing</char>? 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="26" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">Look at the birds of the air</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">how they don’t sow seed</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">and they don’t harvest</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">and they don’t gather into barns</char>; 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          and yet <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">your Father in the skies</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">feeds</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">them</char>. 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          Aren’t you all <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">much more</char> valuable than <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">they</char>? 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="27" /> And who among you is able to add an hour to your life-span by <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">worry</char>? 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="28" /> And about <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothing</char>, why are you all <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">worrying</char>? 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">Pay attention to the lilies of the field</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">how they grow</char>. 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">They don’t labor</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">and they don’t weave cloth</char>; 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <verse number="29" /> but I say to you all, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          that not even Solomon in all his honor <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothed</char> himself like <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">one of these</char>. 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="30" /> Now, if <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">the grass of the field</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          which is there today and tomorrow is tossed into the furnace, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          is <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothed</char> this way by God, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          won’t he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">much more</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothe</char> you all, who have so little trust?! 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="31" /> So then, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">don’t worry</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “What will we <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">eat</char>?”
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          or “What will we <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">drink</char>?”
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          or “What will we wear for <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">clothing</char>?”
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="32" /> For the nations, they constantly <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">seek for</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">all these-things</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          for <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">your Father in the skies</char> knows that you need <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">all that</char>. 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="33" /> Rather, first <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">seek</char> for <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the Kingdom of God</char>
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">doing-right by him</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">all these-things</char> will be added to you. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="34" /> So then, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">don’t worry</char> about tomorrow. 
        </group>
        <group>
          Tomorrow can <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">worry</char> about itself! 
        </group>
        <group>
          Each day has enough trouble of its own. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
